apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.3-beta

- AnymeX+ TV for LG TVs (test build) with your phone as the remote
  - New: AnymeX+ TV, a small app for LG webOS TVs. Install it from Homebrew Channel (add the repository link from the install notes) or with the .ipk.
  - New: Settings → TV Remote. Tap your TV to open AnymeX+ TV on it and connect, or type this device's address on the TV. The TV asks once to allow the phone.
  - Once connected the phone is the remote: arrows, OK and Back move the highlight on the TV.
  - Play a test video (MP4, MKV, HEVC, HLS or any pasted link) in the TV's own player, with play/pause, seek and stop from the phone.
  - "Copy TV report" collects the TV's model, webOS version and what it can play.
  - This is a test build to prove installing, connecting and playback. Browsing and syncing your logins and addons to the TV come in later betas.
